scenarios.name: first-entry-from-admin-menu
scenarios.why: option 5 of COADM01C (XCTL, context 0): not from this program, so 0000-MAIN INITIALIZEs WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA (page 1); no RECEIVE; 9998-PRIMING-QUERY, then WHEN OTHER: 8000-READ-FORWARD opens C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD from blanks, fetches types 01-07 and an eighth row (CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS, last key 08); 2500-SETUP-MESSAGE: 'Type U to update, D to delete any record'

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: the program builds its own CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (CTLI / COTRTLIC, admin, page 1) and shows page 1

scenarios.name: enter-refreshes-page
scenarios.why: page 1 sent back unchanged: 1200-EDIT-INPUTS finds no action and blank filters; WHEN OTHER reads forward from the first key shown (01) again

scenarios.name: pf8-next-page
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK08 AND CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS: page 2 from the stored last key 08: types 08-12, then +100 -> CA-NEXT-PAGE-NOT-EXISTS and 'No more pages for these search conditions'; the empty rows' action fields protected; CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN set

scenarios.name: pf8-on-last-page
scenarios.why: PF8 with no next page: WHEN OTHER reads page 2 again; 2500-SETUP-MESSAGE (CA-LAST-PAGE-SHOWN) replaces the message with 'No more pages to display'

scenarios.name: pf7-on-first-page
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND CA-FIRST-PAGE: page 1 again, 'No previous pages to display'

scenarios.name: pf7-back-to-first-page
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND NOT CA-FIRST-PAGE: the page number drops to 1 and 8100-READ-BACKWARDS fetches C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD (TR_TYPE < 08, descending) into rows 7..1; since the page is now 1, 2500 also says 'No previous pages to display'

scenarios.name: pf7-back-to-page-2
scenarios.why: WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK07 AND NOT CA-FIRST-PAGE with the page staying above 1 (3 -> 2): 8100-READ-BACKWARDS opens C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD (9500), fetches TR_TYPE < 08 descending into rows 7..1 (07..01), sets CA-NEXT-PAGE-EXISTS and closes the cursor (9550); WS-INFORM-REC-ACTIONS is set, so the info message is not blank (the page-1 PF7 leaves it blank and is bounds-refused). The commarea is a hand-set previous screen: page 3 of seven-row pages needs 15+ types, the seed has 12, so its first key 08 is not what paging alone would leave

scenarios.name: type-filter
scenarios.why: 1220-EDIT-TYPECD accepts 05 (FLG-TYPEFILTER-ISVALID), changed -> the paging state is reset; 1290-CROSS-EDITS' 9100-CHECK-FILTERS counts 1 row; the cursor's type predicate selects REFUND only

scenarios.name: type-filter-not-numeric
scenarios.why: 'AB' IS NOT NUMERIC: 'TYPE CODE FILTER,IF SUPPLIED MUST BE A 2 DIGIT NUMBER', the filter red; WHEN INPUT-ERROR skips the read: the rows in the COMMAREA are shown again, every action field protected

scenarios.name: type-filter-no-match
scenarios.why: type 99: 9100-CHECK-FILTERS counts 0 -> 'No Records found for these filter conditions', the filter red, no read

scenarios.name: desc-filter
scenarios.why: 1230-EDIT-DESC builds the LIKE pattern '%A%'; exactly seven descriptions contain an A (01 02 04 06 07 10 11): the seventh row's look-ahead FETCH returns +100 inside 8000-READ-FORWARD -> no next page

scenarios.name: desc-filter-no-match
scenarios.why: '%XYZ%' matches nothing: 'No Records found for these filter conditions', the description filter red with the cursor

scenarios.name: both-filters
scenarios.why: type 01 and '%PURCH%': both predicates of C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD apply -> PURCHASE alone

scenarios.name: select-delete-asks-confirmation
scenarios.why: 'D' on row 1 (type 08): 1210-EDIT-ARRAY counts one delete, the selection is new (WS-CA-ROW-SELECTED 1); WHEN CCARD-AID-ENTER AND WS-DELETES-REQUESTED > 0 reads the page again, 2300 sets CA-DELETE-REQUESTED, the row is highlighted, the filters protected, 'Delete HIGHLIGHTED row ? Press F10 to confirm'

scenarios.name: pf10-deletes-row
scenarios.why: PF10 with CA-DELETE-REQUESTED and nothing changed: 9300-DELETE-RECORD DELETEs type 08 (no category rows) and SYNCPOINTs; the screen (rows as they were) says 'HIGHLIGHTED row deleted.Hit Enter to continue', the action cleared; then CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and the program's area are INITIALIZEd for a fresh start

scenarios.name: pf10-after-moving-selection
scenarios.why: the 'D' moved to row 2: 1210 sees a different selected row (FLG-ROW-SELECTION-CHANGED-YES), so PF10 is treated as ENTER: no DELETE, row 2 (type 09) highlighted and the confirmation asked again

scenarios.name: select-update-unchanged
scenarios.why: 'U' on row 6 (REVERAL): 1211-EDIT-ARRAY-DESC finds the description unchanged -> 'No change detected with respect to database values.' (not an input error); the row's description unprotected with the cursor, CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED, 'Update HIGHLIGHTED row. Press F10 to save'

scenarios.name: update-new-description

scenarios.name: pf10-saves-update

scenarios.name: update-description-blank

scenarios.name: update-description-not-alphanumeric

scenarios.name: invalid-action-code
scenarios.why: 'X' on row 2: neither D, U nor blank -> 'Action code selected is invalid', the field red

scenarios.name: invalid-key-acts-as-enter

scenarios.name: pf2-to-add-screen

notes: CardDemo's Db2 transaction-type list (transaction CTLI, program COTRTLIC, admin menu option 5): seven types a page from CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE through two Db2 cursors (C-TR-TYPE-FORWARD, and C-TR-TYPE-BACKWARD for PF7), optionally filtered by type code and by a description LIKE pattern; 'D' or 'U' on a row and ENTER asks for confirmation, PF10 DELETEs or UPDATEs it; PF2 goes to COTRTUPC, PF3 back to the admin menu. The paging state, the rows shown and the pending action live in the program's COMMAREA area after CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (rows never fetched are LOW-VALUES); each scenario gives the state the previous screen returned. Both sides run their SQL on one real Db2 (tests/tools/equivalence_db2.py): TRANSACTION_TYPE and TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY are created from the corpus DDL, seeded before each scenario and both compared after it. The seed is the corpus's DB2LTTYP.ctl and DB2LTCAT.ctl INSERTs unchanged, plus five types (08-12) without category rows in a separate INSERT, written for this case (and carddemo-cotrtupc): the corpus's seven types fill exactly one page, so paging needs more, and a type without category rows can be deleted. The 9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE paths (DSNTIAC is modelled for the SQLCODEs the faults use) run as sql_faults scenarios: a delete refused by the category foreign key (-532), an update or delete of a row gone meanwhile (+100), cursor and priming-query errors. Not covered: the outcomes reachable only with a blank WS-STRING-OUT (the bounds_refused scenarios, which the bounds-checked oracle cannot run), and the PF3-from-COTRTUPC resets, which no CardDemo caller produces (COTRTUPC clears its CARDDEMO-COMMAREA on entry, so its PF3 always returns to the admin menu).
